principle: Capital is the umbrella. Markets owns observable market/reference facts; Trading owns orders, provider effect boundaries, execution and reconciliation; Portfolio owns scenario projection; Risk owns exposure and risk measurement; Research owns model/evidence validation; Governance owns mandate and authorization policy; Accounting owns durable ledger mechanics.

markets.role: public market/reference data, microstructure observations, streaming and market transport qualification

trading.role: provider/private reality, order intent, FIX projection, execution feasibility and execution reconciliation

portfolio.role: portfolio state transformations and caller-supplied counterfactual projections

risk.role: exposure, factor/dependence statistics, expected shortfall and risk-budget measurement

research.role: model monitoring, prospective validation, standards inventory and evidence persistence

governance.role: execution authorization, live-test admission, risk-budget and pre-trade policy gates

dependencyRules.reason: observable market/reference facts must not depend on decision, risk, execution or ledger layers

retainedCompatibilityIdentities.identity: historical Market Capital evidence and fixture names

retiredCompatibilityIdentities.reason: live census found node exporter and shared Prometheus inactive; active Network v2 Prometheus had zero Capital series and did not load the legacy rule group
